Your path

STEP 1
Learn

How you earn
Rent first. Then the 70/30 split.
1
Fees come in
Your students pay their monthly fees to the branch.
2
Rent is paid
The branch rent comes out of the revenue first.
3
Split 70/30
What remains is shared: 70% to you, 30% to Musicoul.
At an average fee of ₹1,500, a branch of 50 students brings in ₹75,000 a month.

The split
70% yours. 30% builds Musicoul.
70/30

Your payment as the teacher of your branch.

After your first year
From teacher to state leader
Teacher-Owner
Teach your own branch. Earn 70% after rent.
₹42K
per month at 50 students*
Area Manager
Your team teaches. You supervise about 15 branches.
₹60K–90K
per month, at 15–22 branches*
District Area Manager
You supervise about 50 branches across the district.
₹1L–1.5L
per month, at 50–75 branches*
State Manager
You supervise 150+ branches across the state.
₹1.5L–3L
per month, at 150–300 branches*
*Pay = branches supervised × a per-branch amount, so it grows with the network. K = thousand, L = lakh (1,00,000). To be confirmed by Musicoul.

Promotion pays more than your own branch: ₹60,000 as Area Manager vs ₹42,000 from 50 students.
150 branches × 50 students = ₹1.125 crore in fees a month. Musicoul’s 30% is ₹27 lakh; ₹10.5 lakh of it pays 10 Area, 3 District and 1 State leader.
Illustrative: ₹1,500 fee, 50 students per branch. Per branch: Area ₹4,000, District ₹2,000, State ₹1,000.
